title: SkillYaml
description: Platform-only skill manifest in the skill folder (skill.yaml): version + metadata. Never injected as LLM procedural instructions. Validated by CI and synced to the Postgres/pgvector Skill Index. Maps to SkillManifest via programs/skill-yaml-to-manifest.md.

name.description: Skill id / folder name (e.g. java-migration); must match skills/<name>/

description.description: Short searchable blurb for Skill Index cards; may mirror SKILL.md summary. Maps to SkillManifest.purpose when purpose is absent.

purpose.description: Optional explicit purpose; preferred source for SkillManifest.purpose

org_allowlist.description: Optional org_ids allowed to discover/mount; empty/omitted = all authenticated orgs (subject to platform policy)
